description: District Secretariat - Galle - The Annual Esala Festival and Procession of Seenigama Sri maha Devol Devalaya Madampagama D/S/Division Galle Disreict
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the scheduled dates for a religious festival (Esala Festival and procession) under the authority of the Pilgrimages Ordinance. It involves a legal/regulatory matter (amendment of previously published dates through statutory authority) rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the specialized non-legal categories. The content focuses on the regulatory framework governing pilgrimages and the official notification of amended dates.
